Subject: Request: Trial allowance amendment for SeedBridge pilot

Hi Ben —

Thanks again for the quick setup. LuminaAI (one of our seed portfolio companies) has been driving a heavy QA/iteration cycle in the sandbox and we're already bumping against the trial allowance you provisioned. They’re seeing real signal and want to extend the pilot run to validate a multi-tenant integration and run a scale load test.

Quick asks:
- Can you extend the trial allowance from 30 days to 60 days for this pilot?
- Can we add an extra 100k token buffer (one-time top-up) so they can finish the load sweep?
- We may need the pilot agreement signed (legal prefers DocuSign). Please let us know if you need a PO or any billing contact.

I've attached a small usage snapshot from LuminaAI (seedbridge_usage_snapshot.csv) so you can see the pattern. We can accept standard Starter pilot terms, but if Redwood needs an amendment or an escrow for credits let me know — we can move quickly.

Appreciate it — Sylvia

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Trial allowance amendment for SeedBridge pilot

Ben / Sylvia —

We can approve a 60-day extension and reserve the 100k token top-up, subject to a quick signed amendment that sets the following guardrails:
- Token allowance: +100,000 tokens one-time, expires 2027-01-15 (60 days from extension start).
- Usage cap: 250k tokens/month after the top-up to prevent runaway consumption during the load sweep.
- Credits held in escrow on our side for the pilot; if usage is under the cap remaining credit will expire.

From an ops perspective we need either: (A) a signed DocuSign amendment referencing deal SB-PLT-2026-0457, or (B) an internal PO from your accounts payable with the allocation code (I will provide). For speed, DocuSign is preferred.

I attached our suggested pilot_agreement_v2.pdf with the amendment language highlighted. Monica, can you prepare the DocuSign envelope and include anchor fields for: credit_amount, expiration_date, allowed_SKUs, and billing_contact?

If SeedBridge legal wants to redline the amendment please send via DocuSign redline or as a PDF with comments; we typically turn around minor redlines in 24 hours.

Marcus
